items.label: Profile
items.content: Senior product leader who takes products from problem definition to launch and ships AI-powered features, with deep first-hand expertise in the social and marketing domain Dash Social serves. Built and shipped multiple products 0 to 1, including an education platform taken from concept to revenue and a $1.2M valuation in 6 months, and an AI-enabled training tool for the Northern Alberta Institute of Technology. Fluent with LLMs in production (Claude, OpenAI): ships AI features and automations and uses AI tooling daily to accelerate personal workflows. Combines product strategy, cross-functional leadership of design and engineering, and rigorous, data-driven decision-making.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: Senior Product Manager · AI-Powered Products · Marketing & Social Domain

body: I'm applying for the Senior Product Manager role because I sit right where this product lives: I've spent years running social and paid media for brands across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok, and I currently lead teams building AI-powered prototypes. I'm both the user Dash Social serves and the person who turns that knowledge into shipped features in my spare time.

I take products from problem definition to launch. I grew an education product from concept to revenue and a $1.2M valuation, shipped a free-roam VR experience that launched at the Telus World of Science, and built an internal marketing automation tool that cut a 90-location brand's ad publishing time by 60%+. Recently, I built an AI-enabled assessment tool for the Northern Alberta Institute of Technology, and I use custom-built AI tools daily to speed up my own workflows.
I live for the ambiguity that is 0-1 product development. It's the skillset I've spent my entire career building.

That experience taught me how to coordinate cross-functional teams, prioritize ruthlessly, and judge where AI genuinely helps users versus where it gets in the way. I'd love to bring that, plus deep marketing-domain fluency, to a Dash Social product pillar. Thank you for considering my application.
